purpose.en: Build the rear shoulders and upper back.

text.zh: 俯身背平，双臂向两侧打开到与背齐平
text.en: Hinge with a flat back and open your arms out level with your back

text.zh: 肘微屈固定，肩胛向中间收
text.en: Keep a soft, fixed elbow and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

text.zh: 不耸肩不甩动，慢慢放下
text.en: Do not shrug or swing, and lower slowly.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
